text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Monday, January 22, 2018 Posted by admin on January 22nd, 2018 
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. Dow stock 52 week lows include General Electric (GE). 
The Market 
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -32 points. 
Friday the Dow was up +53.91 (+0.21%) at 26,071.72. 
Year-to-date the Dow is up +5.47%. 
There were 17 Dow stocks up Friday. 
The Dow stock winners Friday were led by Nike (NKE) +4.84% and Goldman Sachs (GS) +2.05%. 
The Dow stock losers Friday were led by IBM (IBM) -3.99% and General Electric (GE) -3.04%. 
Apple (AAPL -0.45%) was downgraded to ‘Neutral’ from ‘Overweight’ at Atlantic Equities LLP. 
European stocks are higher and Asian markets ended higher. 
The national average price of gasoline is up one-tenth of a cent at $2.538 per gallon.
